title: Proof of Aid evidence manifest (versions 1 and 2)
description: File list of ONE evidence bundle of a claim: the fingerprint of every file whose Merkle root was anchored onchain as evidenceRoots(claimId)[rootIndex]. The manifest is untrusted: a verifier recomputes the Merkle root from the sha256 values (recipe in code/shared/merkle-vectors.json) and accepts the list only if it equals the onchain root. Fingerprints: in version 1 (claims recorded before P8.2) sha256 is the plain SHA-256 of the file. In version 2, files uploaded since P8.2 are salted: sha256 is the commitment SHA-256(salt || file bytes) with a random 32-byte salt, so nobody can confirm a guessed private file from its fingerprint; a public entry publishes its salt so anyone can re-hash the file, a private entry never does. A version 2 entry without a salt is an unsalted file. Privacy rule: a file name and a salt are allowed ONLY when public is true, because names of private files can contain personal data (for example a beneficiary's name) and a published salt would make a private fingerprint guessable again; private files are listed by fingerprint alone. Two entries with the same sha256 are invalid (the Merkle recipe rejects duplicate files); JSON Schema cannot express that uniqueness, so validators must also check it in code. Likewise a version 1 manifest must carry no salt at all; validators check that in code too (kept out of the schema so every consumer can convert it).

version.description: Format version of this manifest: 1 (plain SHA-256, no salts) or 2 (public entries may carry a salt, P8.2).

claimId.description: Onchain claim ID (bytes32, keccak256 of the backend's claim UUID) this bundle belongs to.

rootIndex.description: Position of this bundle in evidenceRoots(claimId): 0 is the original evidence, n is supplementary proof bundle n.

files.description: Every file of the bundle, in any order (the Merkle recipe sorts leaves). Must not be empty; sha256 values must be unique.

bytes32.description: 32 bytes as a 0x-prefixed hex string (64 hex digits).

publicFile.description: A file anyone may download and check. It may carry its file name and, in version 2, its salt.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the file's exact (sanitized) bytes, or SHA-256(salt || bytes) when salt is present.

salt.description: Version 2 only: the 32-byte salt of a salted file, whose fingerprint is SHA-256(salt || file bytes).

name.description: File name shown to visitors. A plain name, without folders.

privateFile.description: A file that stays private to protect beneficiaries. Only its fingerprint is published: no name, no salt, no other field.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the file's exact (sanitized) bytes, or its salted commitment SHA-256(salt || bytes); the salt itself is never published.
